import json,os
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
import re
G=load()
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    s=sep[0]
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,2) and (r,c)!=(0,0) and g[r][c]!=g[0][0]]
    # shape color = most common non-bg non-2 color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=2 and x!=g[0][0])
    col=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in g]
    top=min(r for r,c in cells); bot=max(r for r,c in cells)
    out=[[g[0][0] if x==col else x for x in row] for row in g]
    if s>bot:  # shape above separator -> move down so bot = s-1
        shift=(s-1)-bot
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=col
        row8=bot+shift+1
    else:      # shape below separator -> move up so top = s+1
        shift=(s+1)-top
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=col
        row8=bot+shift+1
    out[row8]=[8]*w
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input']:
    ki=k.replace('input','output')
    print(k, transform(G[k])==G[ki])
print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
